messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — analytics-partner-42 just started a big backfill and bumped into per-key hard caps. they sent a ticket asking for a temporary lift.

sasha: can we avoid touching org-level quotas? thinking proxy-level temp lift that auto-reverts. less blast radius. :thinking_face:

marco: proxy-level sounds fine but we need guardrails — max duration, fade windows, and an event id in the audit log. otherwise ops gets paged for regressions.

kevin: agreed. proposal: `temp_lift` object on key metadata with fields: { amount, expires_at, reason, actor, audit_id }. enforcement at edge-proxy so dedicated routing still respects capacity pools.

hannah: can the console UI expose a one-click temp-lift for Platform Eng? must include mandatory reason and estimated tokens. no free-form. also require 2FA for >24h lifts. :lock:

marco: implementation note — edge proxies already have per-key token counters. we can apply a multiplier for bursts, then surface delta in telemetry. need a safe default multiplier (x2) and absolute hard ceiling.

kevin: also want a throttling taper: immediate extra capacity for 2min then linearly reduce over next 10min to avoid thundering herd after resume.

quota-bot: system: created audit event audit-20240314-9c3f for request `temp_lift` by kevin for key analytics-partner-42, duration=4h, multiplier=2x.

sasha: important: partner keys sometimes live on partner-managed infra (ingest workers). we must verify origin IP + HMAC header before applying lift. otherwise malicious clients could escalate.

hannah: ops question — do we flow these temp lifts into billing signals? partners will expect to be charged or at least informed. add a mark on usage lines and send partner-notice webhook.

marco: telemetry: expose per-key baseline vs lifted tokens in Console chart, and emit `quota.override.*` events to telemetry stream with tags {actor, duration, reason, audit_id}. that makes cost and debug easy.

kevin: rollout plan: feature flag behind `edge.temp_lift` + console beta. start with internal service keys only, then partner keys after manual ops review. canary on one region first.

sasha: permissions: only roles with `quota.admin` can create lifts; `quota.read` sees telemetry. add `revoke` permission too. UI shows pending lifts with a revoke button.

marco: testing: simulation harness needed — replay partner burst traces and assert taper behavior + no cross-org leakage. add e2e for audit emission.

kevin: sequence for on-call: if a temp_lift causes capacity pressure we should auto-fallback to model-variant routing (cheaper model) for that key before cutting service. add an alert if swapped variants >5% requests in 5m.

hannah: documentation: update runbook, console help text, and billing docs. include example curl to create lifts via internal API: 
```
POST /internal/keys/analytics-partner-42/lifts
{ "multiplier": 2, "duration_secs": 14400, "reason": "etl backfill", "actor": "kevin" }
```

kevin: ok I'll draft a spec PR with the data model + console mockups. tagging @sasha @marco for review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
